value.name: Asha infers conflicting timing
value.description: Asha realizes Devin's call about the timing conflicts with the timing she gave Whitfield earlier.
evidence: she only let the four words stand in the yellow square of kitchen light between them and understood, without needing him to say more, that the timing he had been calling about at five forty-three was not the timing she had given Whitfield twenty minutes ago.

value.name: Asha refuses to react
value.description: Asha stays physically still and lets Devin's implied news settle without softening her response.
evidence: Asha did not move when the four words settled.
She kept her weight where it was and her face where it was

value.name: Asha asks for clarification
value.description: Asha asks Devin which part of the situation he means, signaling she wants him to specify the problem.
evidence: Her voice came out level, no rise at the end, no softening underneath

value.name: Devin hesitates at the doorway
value.description: Devin remains at the door, visibly tense as he processes Asha's question.
evidence: Devin's hand stayed on the edge of the door
she watched his jaw set and then ease and then set again

value.name: Asha realizes she has lost standing
value.description: Asha understands that asking Devin for clarification is something she no longer feels entitled to ask.
evidence: she understood that she had just asked him for the one thing she had spent the drive over deciding she no longer had the standing to ask for

value.name: Devin recognizes her challenge
value.description: Devin hears Asha's question as a pointed challenge and understands its implications.
evidence: and that he had heard it that way too

value.name: Asha holds Devin's gaze
value.description: Asha maintains unwavering eye contact and refuses to give the question any follow-up or escape route.
evidence: Asha kept her weight exactly where it was and did not let her eyes leave his.
She did not blink against the kitchen light, did not adjust the briefcase against her thigh, did not give the question she had asked any second life by repeating it.

value.name: Room tension narrows around the doorway
value.description: The refrigerator's hum and the silence between them make the confrontation feel confined to the doorway and Devin's earlier words.
evidence: The refrigerator behind Devin cycled on again, and in the small mechanical hum she heard the room narrow to the breadth of the doorway and the four words he had already spent.

value.name: Asha refuses to spare Devin
value.description: Devin realizes Asha will not soften the confrontation or rescue him from answering.
evidence: she watched him understand that she was not going to spare h
